description: This file defines the class LoggerRoot, which is part of the log4php logging framework. It serves as the root logger in the logging hierarchy, providing methods to initialize and configure the root logger's level and behavior.

classes.name: LoggerRoot
classes.description: Represents the root logger in the PHP log4php framework, managing the top-level logging level and hierarchy behavior.

methods.name: LoggerRoot
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the root logger with an optional log level.

methods.name: getChainedLevel
methods.description: Returns the current log level of the root logger.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level for the root logger.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Deprecated method to set log level, redirects to setLevel.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Overrides parent setting; always returns false as root has no parent.
